key_features: Compatibility: The stylus pencil only works with iPads from 2018 onwards, including iPad Air 11 inch (2026-2024, M4/M3/M2), iPad Air 13 inch (2026-2024, M4/M3/M2), iPad Pro 11 inch (2025-2024, M5/M4), iPad Pro 13 inch (2025-2024, M5/M4), iPad A16/11th (2025), iPad 10th Gen (2022), iPad Pro 11 inch (2022-2018), iPad Pro 12.9 inch (2022-2018), iPad Air 5th/4th/3rd, iPad Mini A17 Pro/7th/6th/5th, and iPad 9th/8th/7th/6th. Please verify your model in [Settings > General > About] before purchasing.
Tilt Sensitivity: The iPad Stylus features tilt sensitivity, allowing you to create varying line thicknesses and shadows by adjusting the angle of your pencil for apple ipad 10th generation.
Palm Rejection: You can comfortably rest your hand on the screen without gloves while using the stylus pen for ipad.
Magnetic Adsorption: The iPad pencil 10th generation magnetically attaches to iPads released from 2018～2026 just like 2nd generation for Apple Pencil. Note: Does not support magnetic charging.
Type-C Fast Charging: Fully charges the ipad pencil in just 15 minutes for up to 9 hours of use. Note: Sleeps after 5 minutes of inactivity to save power.

Power Display: Easily monitor the reside battery life ipad pencil 9th generation with three indicator lights. Three lights on indicate 60%-100%, two lights on indicate 30%-59%, and one light on indicates below 30%

Original Tip: The 1.5mm tip provides pixel-perfect precision and high sensitivity on the iPad, ensuring no delay or interruptions while drawing or writing. Comes with 3 replacement nibs, it’s the perfect alternative to the original 1st generation for apple pencil /2nd generation for apple pencil.

Easy to Use: No Bluetooth or WIFI needed. Just tap the top button to turn on. If it doesn’t work, disconnect the iPad and Appl Pencil: Settings > Bluetooth > Appl Pencil > Tap "i" > Forget this device. Also, go to Settings > Notes > turn off "Only Draw with Appl Pencil."
